subject.title: feat(ui): merge voice and video talk into one button with in-call camera toggle

question: Should the Control UI permanently replace direct video-talk start with voice-first talk plus an in-call camera toggle?
rationale: This is an intentional user-workflow and camera-permission timing change, not a mechanical bug fix, and the `maintainer` label requires human confirmation.

options.title: Adopt voice-first camera upgrade
options.body: Accept the simpler composer and require users to enable camera after the realtime call starts, subject to real browser proof.

options.title: Keep direct video start
options.body: Retain a distinct start-video entry point if immediate camera activation remains a required workflow.

recommendation.title: Adopt voice-first camera upgrade
recommendation.body: Accept the simpler composer and require users to enable camera after the realtime call starts, subject to real browser proof.
